flags.observation: No style text accompanies the candidate; groove, BPM range and genre rotation cannot be verified.
Beat 1 drops "Kayfabe" from the deck title and states the thesis as an unanswered question, which the cold start forbids.
Stand-up setup is relatable, but the punch "make for a much stranger audit" lands flat and name-drops Ptech, FAA, CBOE to normies.
Intro never says who speaks or what the premise is; expert dog whistles are only deck names, no insider date, quote or term.
"The auditors turn another page" is an additive and-then bridge with no therefore/but link to anything before it.
Cut inverts the card: source says software "to stop rogue trading"; the line has JP Morgan seeking software for rogue trading.
Opener stages an FAA team examining blueprints; card and artwork put Ptech itself in the FAA basement. Scene is invented.
"the probe gets too close" gives an abstraction human agency.
Lore claim "the very man financing Ptech" is dropped while the power phrase "blocked by bosses" carries the line.
Dropping "later" from the lore implies the named investor was already on the watch list while funding Ptech; claim strengthened.
"The map points upstairs" makes an object act; cryptic bridge without content.
"Those keys remain with: Tom Ridge's Rubber Stamp" does not parse as a spoken sentence; the listener loses the thread.
Lore point "The Commission never looked into Ptech" shrinks to a dangling "Commission"; the conflict-of-interest claim is lost.
"A second signature appears" is additive and passive; no causal or twisting link.
Leftover power fragment "twenty-four hours" is cut from "before a catastrophe"; the card's timing joke vanishes.
"The missing entries provoke" has bookkeeping entries acting like people.
"why care?" detaches the quote from the director who asked it; listener cannot tell who speaks.
"The analyst reviews" is an empty generic role with no want, wound or grudge and no link to the previous card.
"PNAC's transformation, biological warfare, genotypes" is a noun list, not a sayable claim.
Reordered quote ends on a dangling "a long one"; the PNAC sentence loses its logic when spoken.
"Those figures reach" ties budget figures to the 34 killed bookkeepers, implying a causation the card does not state.
"killed, office moved" reverses the card order; source says the office had just moved back before the deaths.
"due to loss" omits "of accountants"; it reads as financial loss and erases the people who died.
Lore claim about Rumsfeld's war "losing even more money" is dropped; line rests on power text and misses the callback to beat 15.
"After the report disappears" is a temporal and-then bridge and misstates beat 24, where the report was never produced.
"Insurers receive an invoice" invents an event found in neither card text nor artwork.
"house infinitely rich" lacks a verb; the card turn "They told you" and "They were right" is cut, blunting the deck's own punch.
"Powerful institutions get hearings" contradicts beat 27 and card 53, "without a single Congressional hearing"; the punch undercuts itself.
"People are fined for missing receipts." could close any bureaucracy song; no deck name, number or image anchors the outro.
